Our journey

A clear vision.
A considered approach.

The Gupta’s Landscape began with a clear objective: to deliver reliable, creative and professionally executed landscape solutions. Over five years, our capabilities have grown across plantation, garden development, hardscape works, outdoor structures and recreational spaces.

Working across residential, commercial, institutional and hospitality environments has shaped our practical understanding of site conditions, materials, execution, timelines and client expectations. Each project brings an opportunity to create a space that feels right for the people who use it.

Our belief

Nature and architecture.
Better together.

Landscaping is more than adding plants or decorative elements. It is about bringing nature, architecture, design and functionality into balance.

We consider the site, its surroundings, intended use, budget, materials and maintenance needs before planning the execution. Quality, attention to detail, professional supervision and dependable coordination guide the work.

Project experience

Experience across
different settings.

Our project experience includes work associated with Command Hospital and Goenka Group projects in Kolkata, alongside other landscape development and outdoor improvement assignments.

From residential gardens to institutional grounds and hospitality environments, we tailor the solution to the unique requirements of every site.
